description: Language learning for a concrete trip — cocktail depth, interactive modality implied.

conversation.content: I'm going to Rome for two weeks in June and want to learn enough Italian to navigate basic travel situations — ordering food, asking directions, buying train tickets. I don't speak any Italian right now.
Got it. How much time can you commit before the trip, and do you prefer flashcard-style drills, conversation practice, or something else?
I have about 20 hours total. Conversation practice would be great — I retain things better when I actually use them.

expected_goal.sub_goal: travel-level conversational Italian for a two-week trip (ordering, directions, tickets)
